component: Graph API base URL preference updates

source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: Graph computes its API URL when the client accessor is called. OperationSender registers an EwsUrl preference observer over its URL cell, base_url returns the current cloned URL, and UrlPrefObserver replaces the cell after parsing a changed preference. The Graph accessor appends v1.0 to that current value; the batch accessor then appends $batch. Keep this access-time boundary when changing initialization, because constructor-only version insertion does not cover the observed preference-update path. The code assumes an unversioned configuration and adds no empty-path or already-versioned guard. These are bounded static source facts, not a preference-change or network test.
title: Graph version insertion reads the live configured base URL
